observations: Photo 0: Closed laptop with textured dark gray lid, Dell logo visible. Held by a hand with a black wristband. Brick background.

Photo 1: Laptop open, screen showing Windows 'About' page. Processor listed as Intel Core i5-8265U, 1.60 GHz, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD. Keyboard and trackpad visible. Dell logo on bezel. Intel sticker on palm rest.
Photo 2: Laptop open, screen showing Windows 11 default wallpaper. Dell logo on bezel. Brick background. Hand holding bottom edge.
All photos have 'POSTED ON JIJI TOBA OSIBOTE' watermark.

read_from: photo 1 screen: 'Device name: DESKTOP-6XQ28PH' and 'Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8265U CPU @ 1.60 GHz'

claims.evidence: Seller's text and photo 1 screen show Dell and i5-8265U, consistent with Latitude 7400 model. 14-inch screen size is typical for this model.
Photo 1 screen clearly shows 'Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8265U CPU @ 1.60 GHz'.

Photo 1 shows base clock of 1.60 GHz. The i5-8265U is quad-core and can boost to 3.9 GHz, but this is not visible in the photo. The claim is technically correct but not directly verifiable from the photo.

risks.risk: Physical damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the laptop lid, hinges, keyboard, and screen edges from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having moderate wear, which may reduce value.

risks.proof: Screenshot of battery health from Windows Power Management or a battery utility tool.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if battery is degraded (e.g., 50% capacity), which may require replacement.

risks.proof: Video or multiple photos showing the screen with solid colors (white, black, red, green, blue) and close-ups of the bezel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if screen has minor defects, which may reduce value.

risks.proof: Video showing typing and trackpad use, or a photo of the keyboard with all keys pressed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if keyboard/trackpad may have dead keys or unresponsive areas.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports and a video showing a device plugged in and working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if some ports may be non-functional.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the laptop lid, hinges, keyboard, and screen edges from multiple angles.
Video or photos of the screen with solid colors.
Video showing typing and trackpad use.
Close-up photos of all ports with a device plugged in.
response.reason: The laptop's identity and key specifications (brand, model, processor, RAM, SSD) are confirmed by the screen in photo 1. The seller's claims are mostly supported. Hidden risks exist but are common in used laptops and can be priced conservatively. The item can be priced at its worst-case condition based on visible and verifiable data.
